must_haves: model Client (schema.prisma:274) gains notes String @default(\"\"), notesUpdatedAt DateTime?, notesUpdatedBy String? — mirroring BoardCard (schema.prisma:324-329), attribution editor id is a plain String? with NO Prisma relation.

Migration is purely additive (ADD COLUMN only, no table redefinition); it applies cleanly to the existing populated SQLite dev.db and existing clients read back notes=\"\", notesUpdatedAt=null, notesUpdatedBy=null.

GET /api/schedule/clients/:id/notes is gated by requireAuth only (all authenticated roles, NORMAL included) and returns the thin shape { notes, notesUpdatedAt, notesUpdatedBy }; 404 when the client id does not exist.
PUT /api/schedule/clients/:id/notes is gated by requireRole('PM') — admits PM and ADMIN, rejects NORMAL with 403; 404 when the client id does not exist.

Each successful write stamps notesUpdatedAt=new Date() and notesUpdatedBy=req.session.userId (raw user id, NOT username/display name) AND writes exactly one AuditLog entry via logAuditEvent with action 'client.notes.update' and details identifying the client; the write happens first, then the audit call, then the response (matching boardAdmin.ts archive).

The notes write is a single prisma.client.update scoped to { notes, notesUpdatedAt, notesUpdatedBy } that references no other model; NO Assignment/TeamMember/Absence/Holiday row is created, updated, or deleted as a side effect (schedule-domain no-write boundary).
No socket invalidation is emitted for the notes write (follows the existing /clients CRUD convention in schedule.ts, which emits none — NOT the team-members convention).
